sources_quoted.quote: Ability recasts are scheduled on **one shared timeline** (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed *and* no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it *starts* within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`). ... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.
sources_quoted.use: Defines the rotation-order semantics: the emitted order is the chronological cast sequence; a custom cast order only resolves simultaneity (i.e. the t=0 opener permutation and exact ties).

sources_quoted.quote: "modeled": ["P","Q","Q2","W","E","R"] ... "modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)" ... "splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage (12%+2%/100 AP), P 120-splinter +15% AP buff"
sources_quoted.use: Establishes that the scenario knob named by the trailing number is the splinters option (thresholds 40 / 60 / 100 / 120), and that the second Dark Sphere charge is a distinct castable slot (Q2) gated at >= 40 splinters.

Timed fights are named with an explicit 's' suffix, so the bare '60' in the scenario id reads as the splinters option value (60 = the W true-damage threshold), not a duration. Either reading yields the same computation below.

independent_computation.configuration_assumed: Syndra, level 18 (Q5/W5/E5/R3), splinters = 60 (>= the 40 threshold, so two Dark Sphere charges are stocked), fight window long enough to contain >= 7 casts, custom cast order = a priority permutation used only for tie-breaking.

effective_cooldowns.Q (Dark Sphere charge): 7 * 100/(100+30) = 5.3846 s   [7 s recharge, + 30 ability haste from R rank 3's passive]
effective_cooldowns.W (Force of Will): 8 s at rank 5 (0 item haste assumed)
effective_cooldowns.R (Unleashed Power): 80 s -> single cast in the window

schedule: t = 0.00 .. 0.50 : five opening casts fire back-to-back on the shared timeline, because five casts are available at fight start: Dark Sphere charge 1, Dark Sphere charge 2 (the 40-splinter Transcendent stock), Force of Will, Scatter the Weak (0.25 s), Unleashed Power (0.25 s). These occupy order[0..4]; their internal permutation is exactly what the scenario's custom order fixes.
t = 5.385 : first Dark Sphere charge finishes recharging -> order[5] = Q
t = 8.00  : Force of Will off cooldown. The competing candidates are the next Dark Sphere charge at 2 * 5.385 = 10.77 s and Scatter the Weak at 15.25 s. min(8.00, 10.77, 15.25) = 8.00 -> order[6] = W
independent_computation.closed_form_condition: With five opening casts, order[5] = Q at c_Q and order[6] = W iff c_W < 2*c_Q. With uniform ability haste H on W and H+30 on Q: 8/(1+H/100) < 14/(1+(H+30)/100)  <=>  10.4 < 14 + 0.06H, which is true for every H >= 0. The answer W is therefore independent of item ability haste and independent of whether the engine also feeds generic haste into the (affectedByCdr:false) Dark Sphere recharge.
independent_computation.haste_sweep_check: Simulated the shared-timeline greedy for H in {0, 20, 45} ability haste, with and without generic haste applied to Q: five-opener model gives order[6] = W in every case (t = 8.00 / 6.67 / 5.52 s).
independent_computation.counterfactual_reproducing_the_old_value: Drop the second stocked Dark Sphere (i.e. model Syndra as if splinters < 40, one charge, four opening casts): order[0..3] = the four abilities at t~0, order[4] = Q at 5.385 s, order[5] = W at 8.00 s, order[6] = Q at 10.77 s. This reproduces the old leaf value exactly, which identifies the old value as the one-charge model. The wiki text pins two stocked charges at 60 splinters, so the one-charge schedule is the erroneous one.

why_the_verdict: The only thing that can flip this leaf between Q and W is the number of casts available at fight start: five (two Dark Sphere charges) puts W at index 6, four (one charge) puts Q there. Both the ability-haste value and whether Q's recharge is treated as haste-affected are irrelevant to the index-6 identity (proved in closed form above). The cached wiki text states that at 40+ Splinters of Wrath Syndra stocks up to 2 Dark Spheres, and the scenario pins 60 splinters, above that threshold. Therefore the correct 7th cast is Force of Will.
caveats: The scenario definition itself is outside the permitted evidence tree (it lives in scripts/ or tests/), so the level, item haste, fight length and the literal content of the 'custom order' were not read. The computation is deliberately built to be invariant to level-18 haste choices and to the opener permutation; the sweep above documents that invariance.

The one assumption that carries weight is that the trailing '60' selects the splinters option (>= the 40-splinter charge threshold). Its basis is data/champion-audit/batch-6.json ('splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage') plus the corpus naming convention where durations carry an 's' ('time_based_10s'). If instead '60' were a duration and the scenario's splinters were < 40, the four-opener schedule above would apply and the old value Q would be correct; nothing in the exported data supports that reading.
